set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KWYS7H6C4XP4GGERQXXMH98S. Define NodeId, SystemId, RunId, SampleIndex, SamplePeriod, NodeAxis, TimeAxis, RunAxis, FrameWeights, NuisanceMatrix, ParcelTimeSeries, RunTimeSeries, and MultiRunTimeSeries.
